column1: # The shared vocabulary of Lumen (apps/core/lumen-common-strings, tools/i18n/catalog.py; tools/arch/README.md).
# key <TAB> source app <TAB> source key <TAB> English (note). Each text is the source app's translation in all 17 locales,
# byte for byte; the module's res files are generated from this list (catalog.py module) and checked (catalog.py
# validate). Sources are the frozen Z9X apps (they do not change before the 1.1 seam, decision D4); a source is taken only
# where its 17 translations equal the user's own (catalog.py adopt changes no translation). One English text in two
# contexts is two keys (lumen_auto, lumen_auto_short, lumen_auto_output). Not taken, because the grammatical context
# differs: "Connected: %1$s" (X50 remote, masculine in ru, vs the Play 6 speaker) and "Restart now" (the installer
# reboots the projector; Z9X restarts the UI).
